doc.Title: Checksum-NFT
doc.Desc: The Dapp allows users to create NFT checksums which can verify file integrity and origination. The ability to add file-verification checksums to the blockchain solves the problem inherent to checksums since their inception–checksums lack provenance. By creating checksums linked to non-fungible tokens, we provide a means of tracing the checksum back to the minting address. If the originating wallet address of this NFT matches the known wallet address of the expected issuing body, the checksum tied to this NFT can both verify the integrity and the authenticity of a file.

doc.Title: ML Price Prediction (1/2)
doc.Desc: A failed attempt to predict the price of major US stocks ☹️. Alpha Vantage API and Scikit-learn were utilized in a Python environment to gather and preprocess historical stock data. The data was fed to machine learning models such as LSTM and GRU in TensorFlow on Google Collab to predict daily closing prices. Although the results were underwhelming, I wrote a research article on the findings and presented it in front of more than 30 students and faculties from Emory.
